primary_goal: Find a genuinely new nontrivial primitive integer fifth-power identity class.
positive_results: Report separately; a signed result never increments the strictly positive count.
stop_condition: A new independently verified primitive class with completed novelty review and preserved evidence.
progress_policy: Optimize strategy for discovery. Bounded negative results, throughput, proof counts and implementation merges are supporting evidence, not achievement of the discovery goal.
resource_policy: Every computation declares finite time, memory, work and coverage bounds; expand or change strategy from measured evidence. Infinite calculations and division by zero are excluded.
